The salvage crane is broken and
repairs are planned, but monsters
are roaming nearby. Could you
secure the area first?

There's a dish the children love,
and I want them to eat plenty, but
we're short of ingredients, mo!
Please help gather them, mo!

Goods from an important business
deal were stolen before I knew it, mo!
Please get them back, mo!

I heard of a plant that fetches
a high price, mo! I want to make
a profit from it, mo!
Please help me acquire some, mo!

I'll make a profit from that
hugely popular delicious fish dish, mo!
Please catch the fish we need, mo!

I'm running out of stories for
the newspaper, mo! Please guard
an informant bringing us an
especially interesting story, mo!

The Momon Trading Company is
carrying essentials for Nopon,
but its cargo is being targeted, mo!
Please protect the shipment, mo!

My family is finally coming home
from a trip, so I want to prepare a
big feast, but lack ingredients, mo!
Someone please help, mo!

Monster attacks have been frequent
along a trade route. Please rescue
the missing transport group.

Monsters seem to be prowling
around the lumber-processing plant.
Could you patrol the area so that
we can work safely?

It's been raining for days in Blakka.
We need to go there to prevent
landslides, but monsters are running
wild on the way. Please defeat them.

An order has arrived from Superbia.
We need materials for custom-made
furniture. Could the Merc Group
collect some timber?

We're going to Lake Iaaru for a
test of courage, but there seem to
be monsters nearby. Please defeat
them first so they don't interrupt!

A legendary fruit said to cure
all diseases can be found somewhere
on Gula Plateau. Please defeat the
monsters rampaging in that area.

The water tastes and smells strange
compared to before, and some people
have fallen ill after drinking it.
Please inspect Gula's water sources.

So many supplies have been shipped
out of the military port that the
city is running short. Could the
Merc Group help replenish supplies?

The water has recently turned
muddy, possibly due to pollution
caused by monsters. We'd like the
Merc Group to investigate.

The Lumeria Theater Troupe has
arrived in Kannina while touring
Invidia. Please gather materials
for decorating the theater.

Strong gusts damaged the road
and fences on the Onda road bridge
leading to Mantaal. Please help
gather materials for repairs.

A gauge obtainable only through
salvaging has broken down. Please
collect the materials needed
for repairs.

Grogs have multiplied rapidly
near the water source and could
cause a drinking-water shortage.
Could the Merc Group eliminate them?

We're short of plants used in
spice blends. There are many monsters
in the wasteland where they grow.
Could you gather some for us?

Paras have multiplied rapidly
and are putting a strain on the
Divine Beast weapons. Go there
and eliminate them.

A female dignitary from the industrial
city of Ukuriye is due in Alba Margen.
Suspicious people were seen along her route.
Please hurry to the area.

Monsters stole the equipment
from our shop! We know where they
went, so please retrieve it before
they destroy it.

Just as we were planning to do
maintenance, a machine at the dig
site broke down. Please send someone
to collect the parts needed to fix it.

The ether boiler at the mining
site is broken. The special parts
it needs are very rare. Please help
us collect them.

Mo-mo-mo-mo-mo!!
It's so hot I might collapse, mo!
I want to leave, but monsters
are in the way, mo!

Children from the village secretly
visited a distant island and left
something behind. It is too dangerous
to send the children back. Please
find it for them.

I lost the bracelet my grandmother
left me, you see. Could you defeat
the monsters near where I dropped it?

Aunt Correl hasn't heard from Rex lately.
Monsters are blocking the connecting
route. Could you defeat them?

A huge Dringworm has apparently
appeared. Please gather lots of
vegetables to lure it out.

The Divine Beast shines beautifully
at night on Yashima Plateau.
Preparations for the regular Yashima
Festival are behind schedule.
Could you help gather materials?

We want to investigate an area
to see if we can harness the
Divine Beast's electrical energy,
but need nearby monsters defeated.

Crystal-like flowers from Nararia
Snowfield are used in medicinal
decoctions in Teos Aure. Please
escort a shipment of the flowers.

The Luxurian army is inspecting
Gogol nests for safety. Gogols are
fierce, so we'd appreciate your help.

There's supposedly a shop trading
illicit goods with other countries.
We want to investigate, but it's
risky. Please escort our agents.

Monsters are rampaging along
the route used to transport salt
from Gundesu Rock Salt Cavern.
Please drive them off before harm is done.

I dreamed that one day our country
would open its borders, but now that
the chance is here, I'm afraid[ML:Dash ]
Could you bring me something that
lets me experience the outside world?

A monster not previously recorded
in Luxuria was recently discovered.
Please eliminate it before it affects
the ecosystem.
